name: org.vr/vr-mcp
title: VR.org VR / AR / XR Reader
description: Read-only VR / AR / XR news, full-text editorial, events, deals, and buyer guides from VR.org.

tools.name: search_vr_news
tools.description: Returns the latest VR, AR, and XR headlines from VR.org's live aggregated feed plus VR.org originals, newest first. Optionally filter by category and by keywords: every keyword must appear in the headline, snippet, tags or source, in any order, and headline matches are listed first. Use a few keywords ('steam frame price') rather than a sentence, and omit the query for the latest headlines.

query.description: Optional keywords, e.g. 'steam frame price'. All must match, in any order. Omit for the latest headlines.

category.description: Optional category filter: hardware, gaming, software, enterprise, ar, or xr. Omit for all.

tools.name: get_vr_trending
tools.description: Returns the topics currently trending across VR.org's aggregated VR / AR / XR feed.

tools.name: list_vr_originals
tools.description: Returns summaries of VR.org's own editorial articles (reporting, opinion, retrospectives, guides), newest first. Optionally filter by category.

category.description: Optional category filter: hardware, gaming, software, enterprise, ar, or xr. Omit for all.

tools.name: get_vr_article
tools.description: Returns the full content (title, author, date, tags, and the article body HTML) of one VR.org original article identified by its slug.

tools.name: get_vr_events
tools.description: Returns upcoming VR, AR, and XR industry events (conferences, expos, launches) from VR.org's events calendar, soonest first. Set include_past to also include events that have already ended.

include_past.description: Include events that have already ended (default false).

tools.name: get_vr_deals
tools.description: Returns VR.org's current curated product picks in five sections (headsets, AR and XR glasses, accessories, haptics and body tracking, gaming hardware) with prices, badges, and retailer links. Optionally filter to one section.

tools.name: compare_vr_headsets
tools.description: Returns a side-by-side of two headsets (price, badge, description, retailer links) from VR.org's curated catalog. Accepts partial names like 'Quest 3' or 'PSVR2'.

tools.name: get_top_vr_games
tools.description: Returns VR.org's current ranked list of the top VR games.

tools.name: get_top_vr_apps
tools.description: Returns VR.org's current ranked list of the top VR apps and utilities.

tools.name: list_vr_sources
tools.description: Returns the news sources VR.org aggregates, with per-source article counts and status.

tools.name: vr_explain
tools.description: Returns a canonical VR.org answer and the authoritative guide link for a common VR / AR / XR question, covering the main buying guides and product hubs (for example 'what is vr', 'best headset', 'steam frame price', 'meta vr glasses', 'ar glasses', 'vr for beginners').

topic.description: The topic or question, e.g. 'what is vr' or 'steam frame price'.
